title: Filtered colimits of commutative monoids have underlying set colimits
statement: Let $I$ be a small filtered category (nonempty, every pair of objects has a common target, and every pair of parallel arrows can be equalized by postcomposition). Work in a universe containing all objects, arrows and coefficient sets [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $D:I\to\mathrm{CMon}$ be a functor to commutative unital monoids and identity-preserving monoid homomorphisms. A colimit of $D$ exists in commutative monoids [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every colimit cocone $(L,(c_i:D(i)\to L)_i)$ in commutative monoids, the cocone $(|L|,(|c_i|)_i)$ is a colimit of the underlying diagram $i\mapsto|D(i)|$ in sets.

from.place: Historical nearby-duality/alteration branch of lem-trf-local-term-locality, proof (1)--(2), through lem-trf-log-regular-desingularization: monoidal resolution used for the regular modification of nodal pairs; ILO VIII 3.3.15, pp.109--110. Expose VIII, 3.3.2--3.3.13, pp.106--109, especially 3.3.4(ii), 3.3.8--3.3.11, 3.3.13(i),(iii); finite cover as in proof of 3.3.15. Subargument: returned log-fan-chart-blowup proof step(s) 1; Expose VIII 3.1.2--3.1.10, pp.98--100; 3.3.2--3.3.4(ii), p.107; 3.3.12, p.108: sharpening a fixed fs monoid chart. Foundational subargument for fixed-chart sharpening: Zariski logification and extension to the etale site (VIII, opening of section 3 and 3.3.2). Algebraic input for the stalk computation: filtered diagrams with varying prelog monoids, not only constant charts. Underlying-set filtered colimits for the varying monoid and the quotient monoid diagrams.
